subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open read-image media fix should own this issue while preserving the local-media trust boundary?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open candidates choose different trust-boundary shapes and a related security issue affects how local media promotion should be accepted.

options.title: Review the shared bridge PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 or a narrow successor as the primary fix if it passes lint, real behavior proof, and local-media trust review.

options.title: Revive the start-args fallback PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 if maintainers prefer preserving the original read-tool path instead of persisting inline image bytes.

options.title: Pause for Feishu-specific proof
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers separate the shared `read` image gap from the direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and message-tool reports.

recommendation.title: Review the shared bridge PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 or a narrow successor as the primary fix if it passes lint, real behavior proof, and local-media trust review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the current shared agent media delivery files and recent refactor history.
